tile_text: Generative baroque art study inspired by Jan Davidsz de Heem
Elegant tabletop with luminous fruit and deep chiaroscuro
Modern AI pipeline with painterly for museum-grade polish

page_copy.pattern: Baroque still life demands abundant detail, balanced arrangements, and dramatic chiaroscuro that lets luminous fruit and foliage emerge from shadow with restrained, elegant color harmony.
page_copy.action: A generative-first workflow shaped the composition, then selective in-painting and finishing established highlights, edge control, and subtle texture to achieve a painterly, historically faithful presence.
page_copy.measured: Delivers portfolio-ready still life that read as classic baroque at thumbnail and hold up in detail, suitable for print, social showcases, and provenance-anchored digital editions.
